items.title: Stock Market News for Aug 10, 2026
items.summary: Wall Street closed higher on Friday as weak jobs data for July raised hope that the Federal Reserve may hold interest rates steady for longer.

items.title: Zeta Global Holdings (ZETA) Refreshes Its Leadership Team With Two Senior Roles
items.summary: Zeta Global Holdings (NYSE:ZETA) appointed Leah Pope as Chief Marketing Officer, bringing experience from firms such as Salesforce and Adobe. The company promoted Candace Dean to Chief Communications Officer, expanding her remit over corporate and stakeholder messaging. These leadership moves highlight a focus on brand, market positioning, and communication at a time when prior updates have centered on earnings, guidance, and valuation. This kind of leadership shift is not unique to Zeta...

items.title: Palantir vs. Salesforce: Two Visions of Enterprise AI, One Clear Winner
items.summary: Palantir just posted growth numbers that made Wall Street question its own spreadsheets, while Salesforce quietly handed billions back to shareholders. Picking between them means choosing which version of enterprise AI actually survives contact with reality.

items.title: Circle Internet Group vs. Salesforce: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Circle trades at a 45x forward P/E versus Salesforce's 13x, but profitability and cash generation tell starkly different stories.

items.title: Is SOUN Worth Buying as Growth Collides With a Premium Valuation?
items.summary: SoundHound pairs 37.9% projected 2026 revenue growth with OASYS expansion, but premium valuation, losses and cash burn raise execution risk.

items.title: Microsoft Stock's Peak Margin And Its Azure Bill Are The Same Story
items.summary: The risk to Microsoft stock is not demand but what serving that demand now costs, and the company's own outlook already points margins lower.

items.title: Oracle Stock Fell While Its Operating Margin Climbed For A Third Straight Year
items.summary: The build-out that dented gross margin has not stopped the operating line from widening, and that is the number the selling appears to discount.

items.title: DoD Authorizes Salesforce Agentforce 360 at Impact Level 5
